figures.caption: Fig. 2. The proposed asynchronous bundled-data micropipeline. (a) Datapath architecture detailing the routing of handshake and data signals between adjacent stages. (b) Time sequence diagram of the modified protocol. REQpre and ACKpre interface with the previous stage; REQnext and ACKnext interface with the next.

Fig. 3. The hierarchical AER tree structure. Blue lines represent asynchronous handshake signals, and red lines represent address data paths. At each pipeline stage, the accumulated address from the previous stage is multiplexed with the current stage’s event address, merged, and forwarded.
